description: A write_file the ask gate stops on, then prose. Drives approve and decline alike.
_comment: Round one is paced at 400ms a frame rather than the 40ms default, so the tool call lands
about 1.6s after send. Two reasons, and the second is a finding rather than a preference.
A real provider does not emit a tool call 240ms after the request, so the default pacing was
never faithful for a round that ends in one.
And at the default pacing this scenario failed about half the time, with the write refused as
'the vault op review did not happen'. Measured cause, from an instrumented run recorded in the
2026-07-31 Stage 2 run record: the composer's 300ms draft-save debounce and the write-ahead
audit's intent persist both call ConversationStorage.save() for the same conversation, which
is not serialized, so the second swap finds the destination the first has just re-created.
That is a defect in the plugin, not in the driver, and it is deliberately not worked around
anywhere except here, in a declared per-frame delay, with this note beside it.
